title: CCTV captures fatal shooting of vendor in Pagsanjan, Laguna
summary: CTV footage captured the fatal shooting of a vendor crossing a road in Barangay Biñan, Pagsanjan, Laguna, by two motorcycle-riding gunmen on Sunday afternoon.
